quickStart.title: Fetch a repository from the GitHub API
quickStart.description: This request needs no API key. It returns the HTTP status and repository name; the response body is parsed as JSON before extracting the name.
quickStart.note: The result above assumes a successful request. Check the HTTP status before using the body: GitHub can return an error or rate-limit the request. Calls are synchronous and the response is buffered in memory.

introduction.title: Bring a small API response into a SQL query
paragraphs: HTTP Client adds functions for making HTTP requests from DuckDB. A call returns the response status, headers, and body, which you can inspect and parse with SQL before storing or joining the result.

Use it to look up API metadata, inspect an endpoint, or enrich a small set of records. Calls wait for the response and buffer it in memory. Check the status before reading the body, and save responses to a table when later queries should reuse the same data.
